request.style: English, male baritone solo with gentle choir, piano, strings, harp, flute, hopeful and majestic, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I still have much to tell you
But you cannot bear it now
The path is long and wide
I am going to the Father now

[Verse]
When the Spirit of truth comes
He will guide you gently
He will not speak on his own
But speak whatever he hears

[Chorus]
He will declare to you
The things that are coming
Into all the truth he leads
And your heart is humming

[Verse]
He will glorify me
Taking what is mine to speak
All that the Father has
Is given to us to keep

[Chorus]
He will declare to you
The things that are coming
Into all the truth he leads
And your heart is humming

[Bridge]
A little while and you will lose sight
And again a little while
You will see me in the light
No longer hidden from the night

[Outro]
Into all the truth he guides
The Spirit of truth
